title: The fixed canonical tensor presentation computes the ordinary pullback tensor model
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings and f:X→Y a scheme morphism, using [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Use the fixed canonical balanced presentation tY=canonicalCoefficientTensorNormalization a Y of [lem-sfb-canonical-coefficient-tensor-normalization], not an arbitrary presentation or scalar pullback comparison. For every homotopy complex P let c,T_P,C_P be the explicit comparisons of [def-sfb-internal-scalar-tensor-pull-models]. Pull back tY.derived at Qh P, apply the native derived tensor pullback comparison at Qh P and B_Y, tensor c.hom and apply T_P. This composite equals C_P. No flatness of the coefficient or complex is assumed.

proof.text: Expand scalarTensorPullModelTarget and cancel tensoring scalarTensorRegularPullIso.hom against its inverse. Unfold the canonicalCoefficientTensorNormalization and residueDerivedTensorIso constructors to identify its derived presentation with derivedTensorPresentationIso for H=D a Y ⋙ V a Y and the actual restricted scalar tensorPresentationDerivedCounit. Supply its existing left-derived universal-property instance. No comparison map is inverted in this identification.

Use the native ordinary pullback monoidal structure throughout. Its braiding equation is lem-sfb-native-module-pullback-braiding, proved by the balanced tensor coequalizer calculation. Give its derived pullback the canonical residueDerivedMonoidal structure. The existing leftDerivedUpperStarTensor_eq_leftDerivedTensorComparison identifies the native geometric tensor map with its oplax tensorator; residueDerivedMonoidal_counit supplies the required tensor/counit square.

Apply Functor.tensorModelRoute_fac with the preceding tensor/counit and braiding equations, B=B₀ a Y and the fixed canonical scalar presentation. The output is precisely the desired equality after unfolding scalarTensorPullModelMap and cancellation of the coefficient identification from step 1. This applies to every homotopy complex, with no flatness assumption on it or the coefficient.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_tensor_pull_route_model (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Modules Λ Y) (.up ℤ)) :
    (L Λ f).map ((canonicalCoefficientTensorNormalization a Y).derived.hom.app
      (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        ((CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarTensor Λ f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)).app (B a Y) ≫
        ((L Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ◁ (scalarTensorRegularPullIso a f).hom) ≫
        scalarTensorPullModelTarget a f P = scalarTensorPullModelMap a f P
